title: Extensions Settings
description: Performance profiling, slow-extension warnings, and extension logging.

logLevel.label: Extensions Log Level
logLevel.help: Minimum severity written to logs/extensions.log for extension events and extension-emitted log messages. Set to debug while developing or troubleshooting an extension.

profileSampleRate.label: Performance profiling (1 in N requests)
profileSampleRate.help: Production only. 0 disables profiling entirely. 50 samples 1 in 50 requests. 1 profiles every request. Development and preview always profile fully.

budgetMsPerExtension.label: Per-extension slow warning (ms / request)
budgetMsPerExtension.help: Warn when a single extension adds more than this many milliseconds to a request. 0 disables the warning.

budgetMsPerStack.label: Total extension slow warning (ms / request)
budgetMsPerStack.help: Warn when all extensions combined add more than this many milliseconds to a request. 0 disables the warning.
